result.reason: The clause does not reach either playbook position. It leaves Vendor free to assign to a merger/acquisition or asset-sale successor without Customer consent, subject only to the existing competitor exception, whereas the preferred position requires Customer consent for all Vendor assignments and prohibits assignment to a Customer competitor. It also lacks the written notice required by the fallback. In addition, the new unconditional Corio successor right conflicts with the retained competitor-consent exception, and “in whole or in part” unnecessarily expands the requested assignment right. No Vendor termination right is introduced, and unrelated commercial provisions are unchanged.
